data.title: Mangrove Creek Beach
data.about:
Discover luxurious living at Mangrove Emaar, a new residential enclave situated in the heart of Creek Beach within the prestigious Dubai Creek Harbour (DHC). 

This exceptional Mangrove Emaar location offers a range of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments available for sale, perfectly positioned next to a serene park. Each residence at Mangrove Emaar is meticulously crafted to enhance the quality of life, with spacious interiors that maximize both comfort and natural light.

The modern elegance of the design is complemented by private balconies or terraces that offer panoramic views of the lush parkland, creating a tranquil resort-like atmosphere. Mangrove Creek Beach Residents have access to superior amenities and services, along with an extensive road network that connects them to the vibrant life of Dubai. The community also features 700 meters of immaculate white sands at Creek Beach, a stunning infinity pool, and exceptional sunset views, making Mangrove Emaar DHC an ideal home for a family-friendly retreat.

  • Lush Surroundings: Located next to a lush park and close to The Viewing Point for breathtaking sunset views.
  • Comprehensive Amenities: Features a wide array of world-class amenities, enhancing every aspect of residential life at Mangrove Emaar.
  • Elegant Residences: 1 to 3 BR Apartments for sale, showcasing sophisticated yet simple design aesthetics.
  • Urban Connectivity: Perfectly positioned minutes away from iconic locations like Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai; just 10 minutes drive and 15 minutes from Dubai International Airport.
  • Natural Sanctuary: Adjacent to a wildlife sanctuary that is home to exotic pink flamingos, enriching the ecological allure of Mangrove Emaar location.
  • Vibrant Lifestyle: Offers immediate access to an array of shopping, dining, and leisure options, enriching the lifestyle at Mangrove Emaar for sale.
  • Community Benefits: Footsteps away from a world of dining, retail, and leisure facilities, ensuring a vibrant community life at Mangrove Emaar.

location_tile.title: A Unique Location at Mangrove Creek Beach
location_tile.heading: LOCATION
location_tile.description:
Located in the dynamic Dubai Creek Harbour, Mangrove Emaar is part of a bold and innovative vision for Dubai, setting new standards in architecture and lifestyle. This notable waterfront area features Creek Beach, the city’s first urban beach right at the core of Mangrove Emaar DHC, along the historic Dubai Creek. Residents and visitors can revel in the family-friendly atmosphere with 700 metres of immaculate white sand, a striking infinity pool, and panoramic sunset views. Highlighting the skyline, the Dubai Creek Tower, poised to exceed the Burj Khalifa in height, is a testament to Dubai’s futuristic ambitions.

  • 05 Minutes -from Ras al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary
  • 10 Minutes - from Downtown Dubai
  • 15 Minutes - from Dubai Int’l Airport
  • 35 Minutes - from Al Maktoum Int’l Airport
